FAIL_TO_PASS: context: Uses --context to set `this` value
property-read-side-effects: allows disabling side-effects when accessing properties
fail-after-warnings: errors on warnings with --failAfterWarnings
code-splitting-named-inputs: allows defining names via CLI
module-name: generates UMD export with correct name
stdout-single-input: bundles a single input to stdout without modifications
no-color: respects the NO_COLOR environment variable
external-modules: allows external modules to be specified with --external=foo,bar,baz
sourcemap-hidden: omits sourcemap comments
indent-none: disables indentation with --no-indent
no-strict: use no strict option
merge-treeshake-false: sets all tree-shaking to false if one option disables it
stdout-code-splitting: bundles multiple files to stdout while adding file names
external-modules-auto-global: populates options.external with --global keys
sourcemap-newline: adds a newline after the sourceMappingURL comment (#756)
allow-output-prefix: allows output options to be prefixed with "output."
jsx: supports jsx presets via CLI
config-override: overrides config file with command line arguments
interop: does not include the interop block
code-splitting-named-default-inputs: allows defining names via CLI
